task_description: Create a new system user with a given name.
Count the lines in a file with a system tool.
Show the last lines of a log file chosen by the caller.
Encrypt a file with gpg for a recipient.
Calculate the checksum of a file with a system tool.
Run a traceroute to a target address.
Show the certificate of a remote HTTPS host with openssl.
Commit staged changes with a message given by the user.
Validate that a host name has a legal format.
Restart one of the web, database or cache services.
